findings.detail: Tracked file metadata differs from the Git index or a path is missing. Content and staging differences have not been inspected.
findings.next_action: Review working and staged changes locally; preserve important work and test its recovery.

findings.detail: Files exist outside the index. This includes ignored files; importance is unknown.
findings.next_action: Review untracked and ignored work locally and select important non-sensitive files for recovery checks.

findings.detail: Some entries were excluded, unsupported, inaccessible, or beyond scan limits.
findings.next_action: Review excluded content, nested repositories, submodules, and sensitive material with appropriate tools.

findings.detail: Staging is NOT inspected. Staged additions, edits, deletions, and renames can be missed even when every tracked path has matching metadata. Work can exist only in the index's referenced objects.
findings.next_action: Review the staging area independently. Preserve the repository including its index and objects; matching selected working files does not preserve staged-only work.

findings.detail: No network access occurred. Cached refs may be stale or locally edited, and commit objects were not checked.
findings.next_action: Independently verify access to and recovery from the intended remote or backup.

findings.detail: This project has no verified repository restore or runnable-environment evidence. File checks, if present, cover only their explicit selections.
findings.next_action: Restore the repository separately and check history, branches, stashes, required files, and build/runtime behavior.

findings.detail: Only directory entries and file sizes were inspected. Transcripts, databases, credentials, and session contents were not opened; file counts do not establish session counts.
findings.next_action: Use a trusted local backup workflow, then test opening restored sessions in the relevant tool. Do not add transcripts or databases to content verification: they may contain secrets.

items.limits: Byte equality of selected files only, at check time. Does not prove off-device survival, backup independence, permissions, history, application usability, or complete recovery.
items.next_action: Repeat after any source or restored-copy change; independently confirm the backup survives the wipe.

items.limits: Byte equality of selected files only, at check time. Does not prove off-device survival, backup independence, permissions, history, application usability, or complete recovery.
items.next_action: Review each missing, refused, inaccessible, or differing selection and repeat the restore check.

scope: Only explicitly declared roots and selections. No automatic discovery or network access.
privacy: Reports omit paths, filenames, branch names, remote URLs, hashes, and file contents. Item IDs are user supplied. Treat aggregate work metadata as private.
limits: This report is never permission to wipe a machine.
Default assessment reads Git structure and filesystem metadata, not work-file or session contents.
Metadata cannot detect all working or staged changes. Git objects, reflogs, ignored-file rules, and config are not read.
Excluded and undeclared work remains unknown. A concurrent scan is not an atomic snapshot.
Content checks require explicit consent and non-sensitive selections; name exclusions cannot detect embedded secrets.
No backup is created, restored, uploaded, or destroyed. Off-device survival is not established.
